Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a standard TMT-labeled DDA workflow for total protein analysis of tenocytes. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitylome) was performed; the study focused on differential expression between normoxic and hypoxic conditions.

scope: Cell lysis was chemically performed in a pH 8.5 lysis buffer composed of LC-MS grade water (Pierce™, ThermoFisher Scientific, USA) supplemented with 2% SDS (Sigma-Aldrich®, USA), 100 mM Hepes (Sigma-Aldrich®, USA), and 25 mM DTT (Sigma-Aldrich®, USA).
Following the cell lysis step, the samples were sonicated on ice and subsequently heated at 56 °C for 20 min.

Protein lysates were resuspended in 200 µL of 8 M urea (Sigma-Aldrich®, USA), 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8 (Sigma-Aldrich®, USA), and deposited on top of Microcon®-30K devices (Merck-Millipore®, Burlington, MA, USA).
